how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-razorfen-kraul-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1221:obj:1: In Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.
rows.quest:1221:obj:2: Bring 6 ⟦E3⟧, the ⟦E1⟧ and the Crate with Holes to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
rows.quest:1221:details:0: Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world! But they're rare, very rare. The only place to find them is here in the ⟦E4⟧, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.
rows.quest:1221:details:1: And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look! That's why I've ⟦E5⟧ these snufflenose gophers to find them for me. They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.
rows.quest:1221:details:2: It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
rows.quest:1221:completion:0: Great, you got them! I can sell these to my contacts for a bundle!
rows.quest:1221:completion:1: Thanks for the delivery, ⟦4⟧! You are a great partner.
rows.quest:1142:obj:0: Find and return ⟦E6⟧ to Treshala Fallowbrook in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1142:details:0: I have not long to live... so... so... weak.
rows.quest:1142:details:1: B...the b-b-brave dwarf, Lonebrow, has been sent to w-w-warn Falfindel...
rows.quest:1142:details:3: B...my wife, Treshala... her pendant of bonding to me... stolen... by one of the f-f-foul aggressors...
rows.quest:1142:details:4: Find it p-p-please... and return it to Treshala in ⟦E7⟧...
rows.quest:1142:details:5: B...along with w-w-word of my lonely... death.
rows.quest:1142:progress:0: What brings you to my home, ⟦5⟧?
rows.quest:1142:completion:1: B'Tis not fair. Oh, cruel and intolerable world!
rows.quest:1142:completion:2: I must now carry this burden of grief and not let Heralath's work die with him.
rows.quest:1142:completion:3: You were brave to journey from such a dangerous place, ⟦6⟧. But please leave me now.
rows.quest:1144:details:1: You have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.
rows.quest:1144:details:2: You see, I am an entrepreneur. Always out for a copper, as they say. I caught wind that Mebok Mizzyrix was paying well for ⟦E9⟧ from this here pig pen. I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. As you can see, I was a bit wrong!
rows.quest:1144:details:3: Anyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.
rows.quest:1144:completion:0: Thanks again, friend! I told you I'd make it worth your while.
rows.quest:1109:obj:0: Bring 1 pile of ⟦E10⟧ to Master Apothecary Faranell in the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1109:details:0: As you can see, ⟦7⟧, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.
rows.quest:1109:details:1: As the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time!
rows.quest:1109:details:2: You look well traveled for a ⟦8⟧. Perhaps you can aid me.
rows.quest:1109:details:3: I'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...
rows.quest:1109:progress:0: Ah, I see you have returned. Were you able to procure any ⟦E10⟧?
rows.quest:1109:completion:0: Splendid! This is just the start we needed, ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:1101:obj:0: Bring ⟦E12⟧ to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.
rows.quest:1101:details:0: Poor Heralath! And this dwarf... Lonebrow. What a brave soul he was.
rows.quest:1101:details:1: We must not let their valiance go for naught. This crone... Charlga Razorflank ... must be stopped.
rows.quest:1101:details:2: Surely, infiltrating the Kraul will be perilous. There isn't time to send word to ⟦E7⟧. ⟦10⟧, assemble a ⟦E13⟧ to slay the crone.
rows.quest:1101:details:3: Bring me ⟦E12⟧ as proof of demise.
rows.quest:1101:progress:0: So long as Charlga Razorflank is mustering a force in Razorfen Kraul, these lands are in great danger.
rows.quest:1101:completion:0: The crone has been laid to rest. This is fantastic news, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:1101:completion:1: In these times of peril, it is refreshing to see one as brave as yourself.
rows.quest:1101:completion:2: With Razorflank's minions taken care of, our studies in the area can continue. Perhaps now we can gain further knowledge of exactly what happened to corrupt the resting place of Agamaggan.
rows.quest:1101:completion:3: However, I ⟦E14⟧ the answer to that question lies in treachery as well...
rows.quest:1102:details:0: Cairne is a noble leader for uniting our people here on ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:1102:details:1: But I cannot forgive those who drove us from our ancestral lands as easily as some. My people inhabited the southern ⟦E4⟧ for decades. The land was holy to us. But we were driven off by numerous foes.
rows.quest:1102:details:2: BA vengeful fate awaits the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who musters a foul army from within Razorfen Kraul.
rows.quest:1102:details:3: Bring me Razorflank's heart and I can die in peace, ⟦12⟧.
rows.quest:1102:progress:0: Once I know the foul beasts of Razorfen Kraul have been driven from their foul lair, I will be able to rest in peace, knowing that revenge has been served.⟦13⟧⟦14⟧Have you the driven the quilboar from the Kraul? Do you bring to me good news in the ⟦E17⟧ of Razorflank's heart?
rows.quest:1102:completion:0: I see the nasty tribe of Razorfen Kraul now knows the pain of my people. Serves the foul beasts right.
rows.quest:1102:completion:1: To drive one from a holy land is a sin worthy of the most severe revenge.
rows.quest:1102:completion:2: Thank you, ⟦15⟧, for aiding me in my plight.
